description.value: Cast as a reaction while you are falling and within 30 feet of a solid surface, this power halts your fall and keeps you aloft. For the duration, as long as you remain within 30 feet of a solid surface, you have a flying speed of 40 feet, you cannot be knocked prone, and you have advantage on saving throws against being pushed or pulled. When the power ends, you descend gently to the ground if you are within 30 feet of it.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
